refused: wireguard: /etc/wireguard is drwxrwxr-x, owner 0, group 1001: someone other than root owns it or may write it, so a conf planted there while it was so would survive any repair admit made, and wg-quick runs a conf's PostUp as root. Make it root's with no group or other write bit (chown root:root /etc/wireguard && chmod go-w /etc/wireguard), check that every file in it is one you put there, and admit again. Nothing was changed
